title: American Public University System (APUS)
summary: American Public University System (APUS) is a university in Charles Town. This entry compiles College Scorecard figures and related sources; UniRepository is not affiliated with APUS.

sections.heading: What APUS is known for
paragraphs: The American Public University System (APUS) is a private for-profit institution known for its extensive online education programs. It has a large undergraduate enrollment of 40,074 students, reflecting its capacity to serve a diverse and widespread student body. APUS offers a variety of academic programs, with a significant focus on business and health-related fields. Approximately 32.19% of its programs are in business, making it a prominent area of study within the university. Health programs also constitute a notable portion, accounting for about 11.54% of the offerings. This distribution highlights APUS's commitment to providing education in sectors that are in demand and relevant to current job markets.

sections.heading: How to read APUS tuition
paragraphs: The American Public University System (APUS) has a uniform tuition rate of $8,400 for both in-state and out-of-state students. This means that regardless of residency status, students pay the same tuition amount. The total cost of attendance, which includes tuition as well as additional expenses such as fees, books, and supplies, is estimated to be $18,768. Understanding these figures helps prospective students budget for their education at APUS.
